_note: Config for tools/build-demo.mjs — run build-logic.mjs first (it also writes logic-spelling.js): node demos/macs/build-logic.mjs && node tools/build-demo.mjs demos/macs/build.spelling.json. The Spelling Bee is its own Apps Script project (macs-scheduling/spelling_bee) with its own Sheet and no sign-in; its page is a complete document with no template tokens. Demo-only markup edits, never the app's logic: (1) base target becomes _self because the switcher's iframe is this page's home, and the project's vendored server bundle plus mock-competitions.js load ahead of the shim; (2) the embedded organisation crest (a real logo) becomes the same generated badge as the other MACS pages.
